exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Talking About the Book
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lucy: Have you finished reading Tuesdays with Morrie yet?
Tom: Yes, I read the last page last night. I really loved it.
Lucy: Me too. I thought it would be sad, but it is full of hope.
Tom: Exactly. Morrie was very ill, but he was never pessimistic.
Lucy: My favourite idea is that we should choose our own values.
Tom: Mine is that we must keep in touch with good friends.
Lucy: I am going to lend the book to my sister next week.
Tom: Good idea. Everyone should read it at least once.
exercises.translation_cn: 露西问汤姆读完《相约星期二》没;汤姆昨晚读完,很喜欢;露西本以为会很悲伤,结果满是希望;莫里病重却从不悲观;露西最喜欢“自己选择价值观”;汤姆最爱“要和好友保持联系”;露西下周要把书借给妹妹;汤姆说人人都该至少读一遍。

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 About Morrie
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Morrie Schwartz was once a much-loved college professor.
Late in his life, he was weakened by a severe illness.
Even so, he was never filled with despair.
Every Tuesday, his old student Mitch came to visit him.
Their honest talks were later turned into a famous book.
exercises.translation_cn: 莫里·施瓦茨曾是一位深受爱戴的大学教授;晚年被一场重病拖垮了身体;即便如此,他也从未绝望;每个星期二,他的老学生米奇都来探望;他们坦诚的谈话后来被写成了一本著名的书。

questions.stem: What was Morrie's job?
What happened to Morrie late in his life?
Who visited Morrie every Tuesday?
How did Morrie feel about his illness?
options: He never gave in to despair.

questions.stem: What were their talks later turned into?

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 A Proverb About Life
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Anna: Maths is really hard. I am thinking of giving it up.
Ben: Don't! Where there is a will, there is a way.
Anna: But I have tried so many times already.
Ben: Remember, it is easier to succeed if you cooperate with someone.
Anna: So you mean I should ask a friend for help?
Ben: Yes. Two heads are better than one.
Anna: Thanks, Ben. I will ask Lily to study with me tonight.
Ben: Great. You will reach your dream if you stick to it.
exercises.translation_cn: 安娜觉得数学太难,想放弃;本说别放弃,有志者事竟成;安娜说已试了好多次;本说与人合作更容易成功;安娜问是不是该找朋友帮忙;本说是的,人多力量大;安娜决定今晚请莉莉一起学;本说只要坚持就能实现梦想。

questions.stem: What does Anna want to give up?
What proverb does Ben tell her first?
options: Where there is a will, there is a way.

questions.stem: What does Ben suggest Anna do?
Who will Anna study with tonight?
What does Ben say will happen if Anna sticks to it?

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Never Too Old to Learn
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: In most countries, students usually start university at about eighteen.
However, there is no upper age limit for getting a degree.
Recently, more older people have returned to study after years of work.
In one country, a man graduated from university at the age of eighty-eight.
Their stories show that it is never too late to learn.
exercises.translation_cn: 在多数国家,学生大约十八岁上大学;然而,攻读学位并没有年龄上限;最近,越来越多上了年纪的人在工作多年后重返校园;在某个国家,一位男士八十八岁才大学毕业;他们的故事说明,学习永远不嫌晚。

questions.stem: At what age do students usually start university?
Is there an upper age limit for getting a degree?
Who has returned to study recently?
How old was the man who graduated in one country?
What do these stories show?
options: It is never too late to learn.

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Old Friends Meet Again
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: Sam? Is that really you? I have not seen you for ten years!
Sam: Mia! What a surprise. We were such good friends at school.
Mia: I know. I am sorry we lost touch for so long.
Sam: It is my fault too. Life just got busy after university.
Mia: Let us not lose touch again. Shall we have coffee on Saturday?
Sam: I would love that. It is important to keep in touch with old friends.
Mia: A book about friendship reminded me to find you.
Sam: Then I am grateful for that book. See you on Saturday!
exercises.translation_cn: 米娅惊讶地认出了十年未见的萨姆;两人曾是中学好友;米娅为长久失联而抱歉;萨姆说自己也有责任,大学后生活太忙;米娅提议周六一起喝咖啡,别再失联;萨姆欣然答应,说与老友保持联系很重要;米娅说是一本关于友谊的书让她想起去找他;萨姆说那就感谢那本书,周六见。

questions.stem: How long had Mia and Sam not seen each other?
When were Mia and Sam good friends?
When will they meet for coffee?
What reminded Mia to find Sam?
What does Sam say is important?
options: Keeping in touch with old friends.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Make the Most of Today
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is one simple lesson from Morrie's story.
We often get distracted by small and unimportant things.
Yet each ordinary day should be treated as a gift.
Notice the people you love and tell them how you feel.
A life that is fully lived is never wasted.
exercises.translation_cn: 这是莫里的故事给我们的一个简单道理:我们常被琐碎而不重要的事分心;然而,每个平凡的日子都该被当作礼物;留意你所爱的人,并告诉他们你的感受;一段被充分活过的人生,绝不算虚度。

questions.stem: Whose story is this lesson from?
What often distracts us?
How should each ordinary day be treated?
What should we tell the people we love?
What kind of life is never wasted?
options: A life that is fully lived.
